title: ipomoea brevipedicellata
intro: Ipomoea brevipedicellata, commonly known as the Japanese morning glory, is a species of flowering plant in the family Convolvulaceae. This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ipomoea brevipedicellata include reducing oxidative stress, improving insulin sensitivity, and exerting antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
